name: Close
summary: Sales CRM unifying calling, email and SMS in one inbox, for teams that live on the phone.
best_for: inside-sales teams that live on the phone and want calling, SMS and CRM in one place
skip_if: your sales are mostly email or self-serve — a cheaper CRM without built-in calling covers you
honest_knock: The built-in calling is the draw, but call and SMS credits stack on top of the seat price — a '$99' plan can effectively cost ~$160/user once a rep dials 50+ times a day. Great for call-heavy teams, pricey if you barely dial.

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-09-12, read on their own pricing page) Per-seat: Solo $19, Essentials $49, Growth $109 and Scale $149 per user/mo, or $9, $35, $99 and $139 billed annually — the same twelve amounts we have now read on 23 July, 3, 11 and 14 August and 12 September 2026. No free plan; the trial runs 14 days and close.com states no credit card is required, with $5 of calling and enrichment credits included, and the page carries a 30-day money-back guarantee. AI credits are pooled per tier (500 a month on Solo, then 1,000, 1,500 and 2,000 per user up to 10,000, 15,000 and 20,000). Chloe, the AI sales agent Close now leads the page with, is free to access on every plan but spends those AI credits plus telephony as she works, so she is metered rather than included. Call minutes, SMS and dialer credits are billed separately and can meaningfully raise the real cost: outbound calls run about $0.02 a minute and phone lines start at about $1 a month. The Call Assistant add-on is $50 a month per organisation plus $0.02 a minute, and additional organisations are $50 a month each, with Growth and Scale including one free secondary org. Premium Phone Numbers are listed as a feature with no price attached.
